title: Living Balls!
body:
### Mods.
To use this texture pack, you need to install the [ETF (Entity Texture Features)](https://modrinth.com/project/BVzZfTc1). Without it, the texture pack will **not work!** 
                                                                            
### What is this?
Living Balls! This is a texture pack that turns armadillos into sports balls.
Now, when armadillos get scared, they randomly transform into one of four types of sports balls:
- Soccer ball
- Basketball
- Volleyball
- Beach ball 
                                                                                           
![Balls](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/978d738b2408e694526112592f01d3678a99d848.png)
### Why?
Why not? :)                                                                                                         
With this texture pack, you and your friends can play soccer, basketball, volleyball, or just have fun on the beach!

### A little backstory.
The idea for this texture pack came to me while hanging out with my friends in Discord. One of them said it would be awesome if someone made a texture pack like this.
I thought it sounded like a fun idea, and without hesitation, I got to work.
